# INSTAR

> A school for the cryptography Cicada 3301 actually used. Original puzzle. Not a Liber Primus solve. Not affiliated.

- Version: 1.1.2
- Live: https://instar.jonbailey.xyz/
- Workbench: https://instar.jonbailey.xyz/workbench/
- Manual: https://instar.jonbailey.xyz/manual/

## What it is

Seven in-browser molts teaching Atbash/Vigenere, book ciphers, LSB steganography, audio spectrograms, toy RSA, and futhorc runes. Hidden files are real files. Answers are hashed. There is no recruiter.

The workbench is an open laboratory (live ciphers, frequency, bit-planes, STFT controls, RSA proof steps). Progress is local. The school works offline as a PWA.

## What it is not

Not Cicada 3301. Not a hidden service. Not a request for personal data. Liber Primus pages remain unsolved here. Page 56 is taught as a payload reading at /husk/, not as a preimage search.
